blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions.
To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 549 sessions, 104 trajectories, and 2,719 candidates, spanning both objective and open-ended questions. Each session is a video with fine-grained annotations, and sessions within a trajectory revolve around related activities. Models then use persistent memory to answer questions about past sessions and provide proactive responses while maintaining real-time interaction. This raises challenges: persistent memory must be storable, selectively retain information, be injected at the right time, and remain efficient. Moreover, finite storage may leave required evidence unavailable, so assistants should recognize missing evidence. Therefore, we systematically evaluate general video models under different memory protocols and diverse specialized streaming memory systems, and test whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence. Our evaluation reveals a clear utility–latency–storage trade-off: existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, low overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions. APM-Bench provides a comprehensive testbed for developing and comparing persistent memory systems under realistic streaming conditions. We hope it encourages future work that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage toward more practical persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.
blocks.zh:
为了作为现实世界的个人助手,流传的视频模型需要持续的内存来保留过去的经验,以便日后使用. 然而,现有的流媒体基准和方法往往侧重于单个连续视频或短片,忽略了现实世界的互动经常是断断续续的,需要内存在中断中持续.
为了填补这一空白,我们引入了APM-Bench,它将现实世界的流线交互重新塑造为多会的活道. 它包括549个会议、104个轨道和2 719名候选人,涉及客观和开放式的问题。 每场会议都是一段带精细说明的视频,轨迹内的会议围绕着相关活动. 模型然后使用持久的内存来回答关于过去会议的问题,并提供主动的回答,同时保持实时的互动. 这提出了挑战:持续的记忆必须是可储存的,有选择地保留信息,在适当的时候注入,并保持效率. 此外,有限的储存可能使所需证据无法提供,因此助理人员应确认缺失的证据。 因此,我们系统地评价不同内存协议下的一般视频模型和不同的专业流传存储系统,并测试模型是否承认证据不足. 我们的评价揭示了一种明显的效用-相关性-储存取舍:现行方法仍然难以同时实现可靠的长期召回、低间接费用和跨会的有效主动援助。 APM-Bench为在现实流化条件下开发并比较持久性内存系统提供了一个全面的测试台. 我们希望它鼓励今后的工作,共同考虑效用、耐用性和储存,为现实世界的流派助手提供更切合实际的持续记忆。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Streaming video models increasingly support continuous perception, real-time interaction, and proactive assistance ( Yao et al., 2026 ; Ant Group, 2026 ) , showing their potential as personal assistants; memory is key to making such assistants truly personal by retaining and reusing user-specific experience over time. However, most existing benchmarks and methods study memory within a single continuous video, typically over a limited time span. In the real world, interactions are intermittent: users may turn off smart glasses and resume using the assistant hours or days later. The assistant must therefore retain and use relevant visual evidence from earlier interactions to answer later questions and provide proactive assistance.
blocks.zh: 流放视频模式日益支持持续感知,实时互动,以及主动援助(姚等,2026;Ant Group,2026),展现出他们作为个人助理的潜力;记忆是让这些助理真正成为个人的关键,通过长期保留和再利用用户特定的经验. 然而,大多数现有的基准和方法在单个连续视频中研究内存,通常在有限的时间段内进行. 在现实世界中,交互是断断续续的:用户可能关闭智能眼镜,并在数小时或数天后恢复使用助手. 因此,助理必须保留和利用早期互动中的相关视觉证据,以回答后期问题并主动提供协助。

Across sessions, the assistant updates and reuses persistent memory for cross-session understanding and proactive assistance while continuing real-time perception. The example shows repeated collaborative dessert-making across multiple sessions.

blocks.en: This calls for persistent memory : a storable record of past experience that remains available after an interaction ends and can be reused in later interactions. For real-world assistants, such memory must support later tasks while keeping storage and response latency manageable . Yet existing evaluations rarely assess memory utility together with these deployment costs. Streaming video benchmarks evaluate understanding within individual videos ( Li et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) and extend interaction to longer continuous streams ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . At much longer timescales, benchmarks assess streaming episodic memory ( Forte et al., 2026 ) and long-term proactive service ( Sitong et al., 2026 ) , while proactive interaction benchmarks evaluate when models should respond and what assistance they should provide ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Ran et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Overall, previous evaluations do not yet provide a clear picture of how persistent memory supports retrospective understanding and proactive assistance across temporally separated interactions while balancing utility, storage, and response latency.
blocks.zh: 这需要持续的内存:对以往经验的可存储记录,在互动结束后仍可使用,可在后期互动中再用. 对于现实世界的助理来说,这种记忆必须支持后期的任务,同时保持存储和反应的延迟性。 然而,现有的评价很少评估内存效用以及这些部署费用。 流出视频基准评价单个视频内部的理解(Li等,2025;Lin等,2024)并扩展互动至更长时间的连续流(Zhang等,2026b. 在更长的时间尺度上,基准评估了流传的瞬间记忆(Forte等,2026年)和长期的主动服务(Sitong等,2026年),而主动互动基准则评价模型何时应作出反应和应提供何种援助(Zhang等,2025c;Ran等,2026年;Zhao等,2026年)。 总体而言,以往的评价尚未清楚地说明持续记忆如何支持在时间上分开的相互作用中进行追溯性理解和主动援助,同时平衡效用、储存和反应延迟。

blocks.en: To simulate such intermittent real-world use, we introduce APM-Bench , which organizes egocentric experience into multi-session life trajectories, as shown in Figure 1 . Sessions within a trajectory contain related activities and preserve their temporal order and time gaps. Each session includes fine-grained annotations of evidence time intervals, query times, reference proactive responses, etc. This organization naturally reduces the total video duration relative to a complete life log and enables us to compare memory effectiveness, storage costs, and response latency. APM-Bench evaluates three capabilities through 12 tasks: Cross-session Understanding measures how well models use memory to answer questions about past sessions; Real-time Perception assesses models’ ability to understand the current visual scene and how memory affects this ability; and Adaptive Response evaluates whether models provide appropriate help when needed and remain silent otherwise, with the help of memory.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟这种间歇性真实世界的使用,我们引入了APM-Bench,它把以自负为中心的经验组织到多会场的生命轨迹中,如图1所示。 轨迹内的会话包含相关活动并保持其时间顺序和时间间隔。 每个会话都包含精细地说明证据时间间隔,查询时间,参考主动回复等内容. 这个组织自然会比完整的寿命日志缩短视频总持续时间,使我们能够比较内存的有效性,存储成本和反应延迟. APM-Bench通过12项任务评价了三项能力: 闭会期间 了解模型如何很好地使用内存来回答关于过去会议的问题; 实时感知评估模型理解当前视觉场景的能力以及内存如何影响这种能力; 适应性反应评价模型是否在需要时提供适当帮助,并在记忆的帮助下保持沉默。

blocks.en: APM-Bench highlights three challenges in building effective persistent memory for real-world assistants. First, what to store : to make past experience available in later sessions, the simplest strategy is to retain raw video, while compact persistent memory must selectively preserve information and represent it in forms such as visual tokens, structured events, or model parameters. Second, when to use : persistent memory is not necessary for every interaction, and irrelevant historical information can interfere with current perception ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) . Third, efficiency : the latency and storage costs introduced by persistent memory must remain manageable. Moreover, persistent memory cannot retain an unbounded visual history under finite storage, so assistants should acknowledge when relevant evidence is unavailable rather than fabricating an answer.
blocks.zh: APM-Bench强调了在为现实世界助理建立有效的持续记忆方面的三个挑战。 首先,要存储什么:在以后的会话中提供过去的经验,最简单的策略是保留原始的视频,而紧凑的持久性内存必须有选择地保存信息并表现为视觉符号,结构化事件,或模型参数等形式. 第二,何时使用:持续记忆对于每次互动都没有必要,无关的历史信息可以干扰当前认知(沈等,2026;Ge等,2026.). 第三,效率:持续记忆带来的延迟和储存费用必须保持可控。 此外,持续的记忆不能在有限度的存储下保留一个无约束的视觉历史,因此助理们应该承认在缺乏相关证据的情况下,而不是捏造一个答案。

blocks.en: We evaluate general video models by replaying stored videos at query time ( video as memory ) or session summaries supplied with the query ( text as memory ), alongside specialized memory systems. Video as memory preserves visual details but requires more storage, increases latency, and often weakens real-time perception; specialized systems vary widely in efficiency, yet most deliver weak service quality, as illustrated in Figure 2 . Tests with unavailable historical evidence further show that even the strongest general video model struggles to acknowledge insufficient evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在查询时间重放所储存的视频(视频作为内存)或与查询提供的会话摘要(文本作为内存)来评价一般的视频模型,以及专门的内存系统. 作为内存的视频保存了视觉细节,但需要更多的存储,会增加耐久性,并往往会削弱实时感知;专门的系统在效率上差异很大,但大多数提供差的服务质量,如图2所示. 不具备历史证据的测试进一步表明,即使最强通视频模型也难以承认证据不足.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce APM-Bench, with 2,719 human-refined candidates spanning objective and open-ended questions, averaging 69 minutes of video per trajectory. • APM-Bench highlights challenges in making persistent memory practical and jointly evaluates cross-session understanding, real-time perception, and adaptive response within each trajectory, with controlled tests of responses to unavailable historical evidence. • We systematically analyze memory representations and systems across task performance, storage, and latency, revealing the strengths and limitations of existing systems. We hope to encourage research on streaming persistent memory that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage, and to support more usable memory systems for real-world assistants.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Streaming video benchmarks require models to respond as video arrives, using only what they have seen. StreamingBench ( Lin et al., 2024 ) and OVO-Bench ( Li et al., 2025 ) evaluate online understanding; RTV-Bench ( Xun et al., 2025 ) examines continuous perception and reasoning. For interaction, RIVER ( Shi et al., 2026 ) and EgoSAT ( Lei et al., 2026 ) combine retrospective, current, and prospective tasks; PhoStream ( Lu et al., 2026 ) studies mobile scenarios; StreamArena ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) studies hour-scale interaction. Memory and proactive service are also evaluated: EgoStream ( Forte et al., 2026 ) tests episodic recall across horizons, and EgoServe ( Sitong et al., 2026 ) tests long-term proactive service. ESTP-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) , EgoPro-Bench ( Ran et al., 2026 ) , and OmniPro ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) further assess proactive response timing and content. These benchmarks move streaming evaluation toward real assistance, but mostly use single continuous videos, as shown in Table 1 . APM-Bench asks how retained memory supports later interactions across temporally separated sessions, and at what storage and latency cost.
blocks.zh: 视频基准的流出需要模型在视频到达时作出回应,只使用所见所闻. Streaming Bench(Lin等,2024年)和OVO-Bench(Li等,2025年)评价在线理解;RTV-Bench(Xun等,2025年)审查持续认知和推理. 对于相互作用,RIVER(Shi等,2026年)和EgoSAT(Lei等,2026年)结合了追溯性,当前性和预期性的任务;PhoStream(Lu等,2026年)研究了移动情景;Streamarena(Zhang等,2026年b)研究了小时尺度的相互作用. 记忆和主动服务也得到了评价:EgoStream(Forte等,2026年)测试跨地平线的偶发回想,而EgoServe(Sitong等,2026年)测试长期主动服务. ESTP-Bench (Zhang等,2025c.),EgoPro-Bench (Ran等,2026.),和OmniPro (Zhao等,2026.)进一步评估主动反应时间和内容. 如表1所示,这些基准将流媒体评价转向实际援助,但大多使用单一连续视频。 APM-Bench询问所保留的内存如何支持不同时间间隔的会话之间的后期互动,以及存储和延迟成本。

blocks.en: Streaming video memory methods have been extensively studied to determine what to retain from a growing visual stream. Visual representation methods compress features or tokens before passing them to the model ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) or incrementally update stored representations as new frames arrive ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Qu et al., 2026 ) . Structured memories organize history around events ( Zeng et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) or objects and their state changes ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . KV-cache approaches retrieve or compress past states ( Di et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) and organize them hierarchically ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Text-based approaches preserve reasoning traces ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026c ) or structured summaries ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) for later use. Parametric memory systems update model parameters during streaming ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . Yet most approaches manage context within a single continuous video. In real-world use, models need memory that can persist through interruptions, and remain useful when interactions resume. EgoMemo ( Sitong et al., 2026 ) , GROVE ( Gong et al., 2026 ) , and StreamMind ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) construct persistent memory online, but retrieval and reasoning over that memory introduce substantial response latency, weakening time-sensitive adaptive responses. Questions remain about when to use memory, whether persistent state can be stored affordably, and how to respond when required evidence is unavailable.
blocks.zh: 大量研究了流出视频内存方法,以确定从不断增长的视觉流中保留什么. 视觉表现方法在传递到模型之前会压缩特征或符号(Wu等,2026;Liu等,2026a),或随着新帧的到来而逐渐更新所储存的表示(Liu等,2026b;Qu等,2026.). 结构化记忆围绕事件组织历史(曾等,2025;梁等,2026)或物体及其状态变化(董等,2026. KV-cache接近回收或压缩过往状态(Di等,2025;Chen等,2026b),并按等级排列(Zhang等,2026a) 。 。 。 。 以文字为基础的方法保留推理痕迹(Wang等,2026;Liu等,2026c)或结构总结(Jiang等,2026),供后用. 流出期间参数存储系统更新模型参数(Sun等,2026;Chen等,2026a.). 然而,大多数办法都是在一个连续的视频中管理背景的。 在现实世界的用法中,模型需要能够通过中断而持久的内存,并且在恢复相互作用时仍然有用. EgoMemo(Sitong等,2026年),GROVE(Gong等,2026年),和StreamMind(Zhang等,2026年b)在网上构建了持久的记忆,但对于这个记忆的检索和推理引入了实质性的响应潜伏性,削弱了对时间敏感的适应性反应. 关于何时使用内存、持续状态是否能够以承受得起的方式储存、在缺乏必要证据时如何答复等问题仍然存在。

blocks.en: 3 APM-Bench
blocks.zh: 3 杀伤人员地雷

blocks.en: APM-Bench organizes egocentric video streams into multi-session trajectories of related activities, preserving continuous temporal order within sessions and realistic time gaps between them. The benchmark systematically evaluates three complementary capabilities: (1) Cross-session Understanding assesses whether persistent memory reliably retains essential information across completed sessions; (2) Real-time Perception evaluates streaming perception in the current scene, while examining whether incorporating persistent memory impacts real-time perception performance; and (3) Adaptive Response tests whether the model can bridge current scenes with persistent memory to deliver timely, proactive responses. Across these capabilities, we introduce 12 task types categorized into intra-session or inter-session settings based on evidence location, where tasks in the first two families are formulated as multiple-choice questions, while all tasks in Adaptive Response are structured as open-ended questions. Furthermore, a dedicated evaluation set is constructed to examine whether models recognize when required evidence is unavailable rather than fabricate an answer.
blocks.zh: APM-Bench将以自我为中心的视频流组织成相关活动的多会轨迹,在会话中保持持续的时间秩序并保持它们之间现实的时间间隔. 该基准系统评价三个互补能力: (1)跨会理解评估持续内存是否可靠地保留了整个已完成会话中的重要信息;(2)实时感知评价当前场景中的流传感知,同时审查是否纳入了持续内存影响实时感知性能;(3)适应性反应测试模型是否能够将当前场景与持续内存相接以及时,主动的响应. 通过这些能力,我们提出了12个任务类型,根据证据位置分为会内或会间环境,其中头两个家庭的任务被确定为多选择问题,而适应性反应的所有任务则被确定为开放式问题。 此外,还建立了一个专门的评价组,以审查模型是否承认在缺乏必要证据时,而不是伪造答案。

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准建设

blocks.en: Data Source. APM-Bench builds on two egocentric datasets: EgoLife ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , with multi-day recordings, transcripts, and timestamped captions, and HD-EPIC ( Perrett et al., 2025 ) , with fine-grained action and object annotations for structured kitchen procedures.
blocks.zh: 数据来源. APM-Bench基于两个以自负为中心的数据集:EgoLife(Yang等,2025年),配有多日录音,笔录,并打上时间戳的字幕;HD-EPIC(Perret等,2025年),配有结构化厨房程序的精细动作和对象说明.

blocks.en: Construction Pipeline. As illustrated in Figure 5 , APM-Bench is constructed in two stages. In Stage 1 , we organize EgoLife and HD-EPIC videos into activity-related multi-session trajectories with real-world timestamps. In Stage 2 , we generate candidates for the three capability families and filter and refine them through automated and human review, yielding 2,719 candidates. On 300 sampled questions, two annotators reach a Cohen’s kappa of 0.868 0.868 ( Cohen, 1960 ) .
blocks.zh: 建筑管道. 如图5所示,APM-Bench分为两个阶段。 在第一阶段,我们将EgoLife和HD-EPIC的视频组织成与活动有关的多会场轨迹,带有真实世界的时间戳. 在第二阶段,我们为三个能力家庭产生候选人,并通过自动化和人力审查过滤和完善这些候选人,产生2 719名候选人。 在300个抽样问题上,两个注释员到达了科恩的卡帕0.868 0.868 (Cohen,1960.

blocks.en: Evidence Availability-Aware Evaluation Set. Finite storage and compression prevent persistent memory from retaining all visual history. We therefore curate 260 Cross-session Understanding questions to test whether models recognize unavailable evidence. Models access only the two most recent completed sessions before the query: 130 questions have all required evidence within this history, while the other 130 require evidence outside it. Each question includes a coarse time span and a fifth option indicating insufficient available evidence. This setting tests whether models answer when evidence is accessible and acknowledge when it is not.
blocks.zh: 证据提供情况-了解评价 Set. 有限度的存储和压缩会阻止持续的内存保留所有视觉历史. 因此,我们研究了260个跨会议理解问题,以检验模型是否承认没有证据。 模型只访问查询前最近完成的两个会话:130个问题在此历史中都有所有需要的证据,而其他130个问题则需要外出的证据. 每个问题包括一个粗糙的时间跨度和一个表示现有证据不足的第五个选择。 这种设定检验模型在可获取证据时是否回答,在不可获取证据时是否承认。

blocks.en: 3.2 Detail of APM-Bench
blocks.zh: 3.2 杀伤人员地雷详细情况

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , we characterize six streaming formulations of queries, evidence, spanning intra-session and inter-session settings based on evidence location.
blocks.zh: 如图3所说明的,我们根据证据地点,对涉及会内和会间环境的6个查询和证据的流派表述作了描述。

blocks.en: Cross-session Understanding requires evidence from previous sessions. Episodic Recall (ER) recalls or summarizes events and activities from earlier sessions. Entity State Tracking (EST) tracks the states or locations of objects and other entities over time. Temporal Reasoning (TR) compares multiple historical moments to infer event orderings and temporal changes. Tasks in this family are formulated as multiple-choice questions and span single- and multi-evidence temporal grounding.
blocks.zh: 闭会期间 理解需要前几届会议提供的证据。 提醒(ER)回顾或总结前几届会议的事件和活动。 实体国家追踪(EST)跟踪物体和其他实体的状态或位置。 Timoral Reasoning(TR)将多个历史时刻相提并论推断出事件顺序和时间变化. 这一家庭的任务被确定为多重选择问题,跨越单一和多证据的时间基础。

blocks.en: Real-time Perception evaluates understanding of the current visual scene within the ongoing session. Action Recognition (ACR) identifies actions performed by the wearer or nearby individuals. Counting (CT) counts instances of specified entities. Optical Character Recognition (OCR) reads visible text, labels, or screen content. Spatial Understanding (STU) determines spatial relationships among specific entities. Tasks in this family are also formulated as multiple-choice questions.
blocks.zh: 实时感知评价当前视觉场景在进行中的会话中的理解. 动作识别(ACR)识别穿戴者或附近个人的行为. 计数( CT) 计数特定实体的实例 。 光学字符识别(OCR)读取可见文本,标签,或屏幕内容. 空间理解(STU)决定了特定实体之间的空间关系. 这个家庭的任务也成为多重选择问题。

blocks.en: Adaptive Response evaluates whether the model delivers timely assistance when trigger conditions are met and remains silent otherwise. Evidence-Ready Answering (ERA) releases a multiple-choice question before its causal evidence appears; the model must remain SILENT until the evidence is sufficient, then INTERVENE with the selected option and rationale. Registered-Condition Response (RCR) requires the model to detect whether the ongoing scene fulfills a reminder condition registered earlier. Memory-Grounded Proactive Assistance (MPA) leverages past experience without explicit user instructions to offer proactive guidance during related activities, requiring models to connect historical memory with current actions. Proactive Reminder (PRM) triggers a reminder registered in a prior session when conditions arise in a later session. Task Progress Guidance (TPG) tracks progress across long-running tasks and delivers task-relevant assistance upon resumption. ERA and RCR are intra-session tasks confined to the current session, whereas MPA, PRM, and TPG are inter-session tasks that bridge current visual events with persistent historical memory. Except for ERA, the other tasks require outputting the decision, rationale, and response. All adaptive tasks are evaluated in an open-ended format via LLM-as-a-judge.
blocks.zh: 适应性反应评价该模式是否在触发条件得到满足时及时提供援助,并保持沉默。 证据——即时回答(ERA)在其因果证据出现之前就释出一个多选择的问题;模型必须保持SILENT,直到证据足够,然后带有选定的选择和理由. 注册的-条件反应(RCR)需要模型来检测正在进行的场景是否满足了先前注册的提醒条件. 记忆全方位的主动援助(MPA)利用过去的经验,没有明确的用户指示,在相关活动中提供主动指导,需要模型将历史记忆与当前行动联系起来. 主动提醒(PRM)触发了在后一届会议上出现条件时在上一届会议上登记的提醒。 任务进展指导跟踪长期任务的进展情况,并在恢复后提供与任务有关的援助。 ERA和RCR是限于本届会议的会内任务,而MPA、PRM和TPG则是会间任务,将目前的视觉事件同持续的历史记忆相接。 除电子逆向拍卖外,其他任务需要产出决定、理由和反应。 所有适应性任务均通过LLM-as-a-judge以开放式形式进行评估。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 4 , each trajectory contains 69 minutes of video on average, with individual sessions averaging 13 minutes, while its real-world span can extend across hours or days due to inter-session gaps. This separation between video duration and elapsed real-world time reflects the intermittent interactions that persistent memory must support, with more statistics in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 如图4所显示的,每个轨迹平均包含69分钟的视频,单个会话平均13分钟,而由于会间间空档,其真实世界的跨度可长达数小时或数天. 视频持续时间与过去现实世界时间之间的这种分离反映了持续记忆必须支持的间歇性互动,附录C中有更多的统计数据。

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Protocol and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价规程和计量

blocks.en: During inference, models access prior-session persistent memory and the current session’s causal video prefix ending at the probe or query timestamp, strictly adhering to causal constraints. For Adaptive Response, each candidate contains probes at precise timestamps labeled as SILENT or INTERVENE , treating each probe as an independent runtime instance (3,768 in total). Specifically, ERA releases its multiple-choice question at session start without repeating it at subsequent probes; for MPA and TPG, probes provide brief task definitions to guide decisions; RCR and PRM inject textual reminder instructions at registration timestamps. Conversely, candidates in Cross-session Understanding (887) and Real-time Perception (716) each form a single runtime instance evaluated at the query timestamp, requiring the model to directly output option choices.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,模型访问前会场持续内存和当前会场的因果视频前缀以探针或查询时间戳结束,严格遵守因果限制. 就适应性反应而言,每个候选国家都包含精确时间戳标记为SILENT或INTERVENE的探测器,将每个探测器作为独立的运行时间实例处理(共3,768个)。 具体地说,ERA在会话开始时发布其多个选择问题,而在随后的探测中不重复这个问题;对于MPA和TPG,探测器提供简单的任务定义来指导决定;RCR和PRM在登记时间戳上注入文字提醒指示. 相反,跨会理解(887)和实时感知(716)中的候选人各自组成一个在查询时间戳评价的单一运行时间实例,要求模型直接输出选项选择.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate a no-memory baseline and two memory conditions for general video models. SimpleStream uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) with only the four most recent frames as the no-memory baseline. Raw Video as Memory stores all prior-session videos and replays them at query time. Text Summary as Memory generates a summary at the end of each session and provides prior-session summaries together with the current causal video prefix at query time. All models use 1 FPS video input. Proprietary models and Qwen-series models uniformly sample up to 1,024 frames, while InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and VideoLLaMA3-7B ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) sample up to 128 frames.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一般视频模型的无记忆基线和两个内存条件。 SimpleStream使用Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct(Bai等,2025年),只有最近四帧作为无模基线. Raw Video作为记忆存储所有前会场视频,并在查询时间重放. 作为内存的文本摘要在每个会话结束时生成一个摘要,并在查询时提供前会摘要与当前因果视频前缀. 所有型号都使用1个FPS视频输入. 专有型和Quen系列型号统一取样可达1024帧,而InternVL3.5-8B(Wang等,2025年)和VideoLLAMA3-7B(Zhang等,2025年a)取样可达128帧.

blocks.en: We evaluate eight methods across five memory representations: KV Cache , Visual Tokens/Features , Event Tree , Parametric Memory , and Reasoning Thoughts . All use official settings and process prior sessions sequentially. For methods supporting streaming input, latency is measured from the last required memory update to the first output token; otherwise, from processing the causal video prefix to the first output token. As most methods target single continuous videos without persistent-state export, Table 3 estimates storage from the memory state maintained during inference. Implementation details are in Appendix A.1 and A.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五种记忆表达的八种方法:KV 缓存、视觉托肯斯、事件树、参数记忆和理性思想。 全部使用正式设置,并依次处理之前的会话. 对于支持流出输入的方法,耐用度是从最后需要的内存更新到第一个输出符;否则,从处理因果视频前缀到第一个输出符. 由于大多数方法都针对单个连续视频而不持续状态导出,因此表3估计了在推论期间从内存状态所保持的存储. 执行情况详情见附录A.1和A.2。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: What to store is a key design choice for persistent memory. Storing raw video is the simplest strategy and achieves the strongest performance for most general models, but incurs substantial storage and latency costs. Event-structured methods lead among specialized systems, showing their potential as an alternative to raw-video replay.
blocks.zh: 要存储什么是持续内存的关键设计选择. 存储生视频是最简单的策略,并且对大多数一般模型都实现了最强的性能,但需要大量的存储和耐用成本. 事件结构化方法在专门系统中居于领先地位,显示出其作为原始视频重播的替代品的潜力.

blocks.en: Tables 3 and 4 show that richer retained information benefits Cross-session Understanding. Without prior-session memory, SimpleStream performs substantially worse on cross-session tasks. Raw Video as Memory preserves the richest visual evidence and achieves the strongest cross-session performance, whereas Text Summary as Memory loses visual details during summarization and degrades cross-session understanding. Specialized systems adopt different memory representations, including KV caches, visual tokens or features, event structures, parametric memory, and reasoning thoughts. Among them, event-structured methods achieve the strongest utility, suggesting that organizing history around events is a promising alternative to raw-video replay. Parametric memory is also appealing because its state does not grow with video length, although the evaluated method still suffers from limited utility and nontrivial latency. By organizing intermittent interactions into sessions, APM-Bench naturally defines memory-storage boundaries and enables clearer comparison across memory representations, as further analyzed in Appendix B.6 .
blocks.zh: 表3和表4显示,保存更丰富的信息有利于跨部门理解。 没有前会话内存,SimpleStream在跨会话任务上表现得更糟糕. Raw Video as Memory 保存最丰富的视觉证据并实现最强的跨会话性能,而Text Culture as Memory在总结时会失去视觉细节并降解跨会话理解. 专用系统采用不同的内存表示,包括KV缓存,视觉符号或特征,事件结构,参数记忆,和推理思想等. 其中,事件结构化的方法实现了最强的效用,表明围绕事件组织历史是原始视频重播的有希望的替代方案. 参数内存也具有吸引力,因为它的状态不会随着视频长度而增长,尽管被评价的方法仍然受到有限效用和非三角间隔的影响. APM-Bench通过将间歇性互动组织到会话中,自然地定义了存储内存的界限并使得对内存表达的比较更加清晰,附录B.6对此作了进一步分析.

blocks.en: Real-world deployment requires efficient persistent memory. Existing memory systems rarely achieve strong utility, low latency, and low storage cost simultaneously. Practical persistent memory therefore requires jointly optimizing all three dimensions rather than improving any one of them in isolation.
blocks.zh: 现实世界的部署需要有效的持续记忆。 现有的内存系统很少同时实现强功用,低活性,低存储成本. 因此,实际的持续记忆需要共同优化所有三个层面,而不是孤立地改善其中任何一个层面。

blocks.en: The activity-related trajectory design preserves long real-world spans while reducing the amount of video history, making storage and latency easier to measure across methods. Table 3 shows that storage and latency are closely coupled with utility. Raw-video memory achieves strong performance but requires GiB-scale storage and incurs high query-time overhead, while text summaries reduce storage to the KiB scale at the cost of cross-session performance. Specialized memory systems improve efficiency in different ways, but compact or fast methods often sacrifice utility, while stronger systems can require substantially more storage or response time. These results reveal a clear utility–latency–storage trade-off, highlighting the need to jointly consider all three dimensions when designing persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.
blocks.zh: 与活性相关的轨迹设计保留了漫长的现实世界,同时减少了视频历史量,使存储和耐用性更容易跨方法测量. 表3显示,储存和耐用性与效用密切相关。 Raw-video内存实现强性能,但需要GiB级存储,并发生高查询时间间接费用,而文本摘要则以跨会话性能为代价将存储降至KiB级. 专门的内存系统以不同的方式提高了效率,但紧凑或快活的方法往往会牺牲效用,而更强大的系统则需要大量的存储或响应时间. 这些结果揭示了一种明显的效用-相关性-储存取舍,突出表明在为现实世界流派助手设计持续记忆时需要共同考虑所有三个方面。

blocks.en: Persistent memory should be used selectively. Not every interaction benefits from historical information, especially for real-time perception. Historical information should be injected only when relevant to the ongoing interaction.
blocks.zh: 应选择性地使用持续的记忆。 并非每一种互动都受益于历史信息,特别是实时认知。 只有在与正在进行的互动有关的情况下,才应输入历史信息。

blocks.en: Real-time Perception depends on the current visual scene and often does not require prior-session history. As shown in Table 4 , replacing raw-video history with text summaries improves Real-time Perception for most general video models, suggesting that excessive or irrelevant history can interfere with current-scene understanding. This reveals a tension between maintaining rich historical context and accurate real-time perception: information useful for later recall may be unnecessary or distracting in the current interaction.Retaining more history is therefore insufficient; the system must also determine whether that history is useful now and what should be exposed to the model. Persistent memory should therefore be used selectively, injecting historical information only when it is relevant to the ongoing interaction.
blocks.zh: 实时感知取决于目前的视觉场景,往往不需要前会历史. 如表4所显示的,用文本摘要来取而代之的原始视频历史可以改善大多数一般视频模型的实时感知,说明过度或无关的历史可以干扰当前场景的理解. 这揭示了保持丰富的历史背景与准确的实时感知之间的紧张关系:对于以后的召回有用的信息在目前的互动中可能是不必要的或分散注意力的. 因此,保留更多的历史是不够的;该系统还必须确定这一历史现在是否有用,以及应当暴露于何种模式。 因此,应当有选择地使用持续的记忆,只有在历史信息与正在进行的互动相关时,才能注入这种信息。

blocks.en: Reliable deployment requires awareness of evidence availability. Answering with available evidence and recognizing missing evidence are distinct capabilities. Persistent memory systems should make the coverage of retained history explicit so that assistants can identify when required evidence is missing.
blocks.zh: 可靠的部署需要了解是否有证据。 以现有证据作答并承认缺少证据是独特的能力。 持续的内存系统应使保留历史的覆盖面明确,以便助理在缺少必要证据时能够识别。

blocks.en: On the Evidence Availability-Aware evaluation, Gemini 3.6 Flash performs strongly when the required evidence remains accessible but is less reliable at recognizing when it is unavailable. SimpleStream shows the opposite pattern: with only the four most recent frames, it strongly favors the insufficient-evidence option but rarely answers correctly when historical evidence is available. These contrasting cases show that successful recall does not imply reliable awareness of what evidence remains accessible. One practical direction is to make the coverage of retained history explicit, enabling the assistant to recognize when required evidence is unavailable rather than fabricate an answer. Appendix B.7 further compares the original 4-way MCQA accuracy of questions used to construct this set with their 5-way accuracy when the required evidence remains available.
blocks.zh: 关于证据可获得性 -- -- 知识评价,双子座3.6 当所需证据仍可获取时,闪光效果强劲,但在无法获取时,识别证据的可靠性较低。 SimpleStream显示了相反的模式:只有最近四个框架,它强烈赞成证据不足选项,但在有历史证据时很少正确回答. 这些对比性案例表明,成功召回并不意味着可靠地了解哪些证据仍可获取。 一个实际方向是明确涵盖保留的历史,使助理能够在缺乏必要证据时确认,而不是捏造答案。 附录B.7进一步比较了用于构建这组问题的最初4向MCQA的准确性,以及在仍有所需证据时的5向准确性。

blocks.en: 4.3 Why Adaptive Response Remains Difficult
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 为什么适应性反应仍然困难

blocks.en: Adaptive Response remains the most challenging capability even for the strongest general video models. The task-level results in Table 4 show a clear distinction between assistance driven by explicit registrations and fully autonomous proactive assistance. RCR and PRM provide the model with a previously registered condition or reminder, giving it a concrete target to monitor in the current scene. Models perform substantially better under these paradigms than on MPA and TPG, where no explicit trigger specifies which historical experience should become relevant.
blocks.zh: 适应性反应仍然是最具挑战性的能力,即使是最强的一般视频模型也是如此。 表4中的任务层面结果表明,明确登记所推动的援助与完全自主的主动援助之间有明显的区别。 RCR和PRM为模型提供了先前注册的条件或提醒,赋予它在当前场景中监控的具体目标. 在这些模式下,模型的绩效大大好于海洋保护区和TPG模式,因为后者没有明确的触发因素规定哪些历史经验应具有相关性。

blocks.en: MPA and TPG require models to connect relevant past experience to the current scene, decide whether to intervene, and provide useful assistance. Richer history alone does not solve this: even with Raw Video as Memory, the strongest general model remains weak on these tasks despite much stronger Cross-session Understanding. As further shown in Appendix B.6 , even when given only the necessary historical evidence, models still struggle on Adaptive Response , indicating that relating past evidence to the current scene and turning it into useful assistance remains difficult. Further analyses in Appendix B.1 and Appendix B.2 examine decision accuracy and response quality after correct decisions, respectively.
blocks.zh: 海洋保护区和TPG要求模型将过去的相关经验与目前的情况联系起来,决定是否进行干预,并提供有益的援助。 仅靠更丰富的历史并不能解决这个问题:即使以Raw Video作为记忆,最强大的一般模型在这些任务上仍然软弱无力,尽管更强大的交叉会话理解. 如附录B.6所进一步显示的,即使只提供了必要的历史证据,模型在适应性反应方面仍然有困难,表明将过去的证据与目前的情况联系起来并将其转化为有用的援助仍然很困难。 附录B.1和附录B.2中的进一步分析分别审查了在作出正确决定后所作决定的准确性和答复的质量。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce APM-Bench, which organizes egocentric experience into activity-related multi-session trajectories to simulate intermittent real-world use and evaluate persistent memory in streaming video models. A useful persistent memory must be storable and reusable across sessions, while carefully balancing what to store, when to use it, and efficiency.
Our experiments reveal clear trade-offs. Raw video preserves the richest visual evidence and achieves the strongest cross-session performance, but incurs substantial storage and latency costs. Compact representations reduce these costs but may lose details needed later; among specialized systems, event-structured memory shows the strongest utility. Excessive history can impair real-time perception, motivating selective memory use. Moreover, strong recall ability does not guarantee awareness when required evidence is unavailable, and adaptive response remains challenging even with rich historical context. Overall, current methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, selective memory use, low storage and latency overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions.
blocks.zh:
我们引入APM-Bench,将自我中心经验组织到与活动有关的多会场轨迹中来模拟间歇性真实世界的使用并评价流出视频模型中的持续记忆. 一个有用的持续记忆必须是可储存的,在各个会话中重复使用,同时谨慎地平衡储存什么、何时使用以及效率。
我们的实验揭示了明确的取舍. 原始视频保存了最丰富的视觉证据,并实现了最强的跨会场性能,但产生了大量的存储和耐久成本. 契约表述减少了这些费用,但以后可能失去所需的细节;在专门系统中,事件结构记忆显示出最强的效用。 过度的历史会损害实时感知,促使选择性地使用记忆. 此外,强大的召回能力不能保证在缺乏必要证据时提高认识,即使在丰富的历史背景下,适应性对策仍然具有挑战性。 总体而言,目前的方法仍然难以同时实现可靠的长期召回、有选择地使用内存、低存储率和长期性管理费以及跨会的有效主动援助。

blocks.en: The automated scorer tolerates format errors that it can repair deterministically. It marks a response incorrect only when no unambiguous task output can be recovered. blocks.en: D.1 Dataset construction

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 5 , APM-Bench is constructed in two stages. In Stage 1 , we organize raw videos into activity-related trajectories. For EgoLife, GPT-5-mini generates hierarchical summaries at hourly and daily scales, and GPT-5.4 mines 165 trajectory proposals from the daily summaries. Human annotators retain 76 valid trajectories comprising 472 sessions. For HD-EPIC, recipe-stage annotations yield 34 trajectory proposals, of which 28 trajectories spanning 77 sessions remain after human verification. For HD-EPIC session videos without visible timestamps, we render real-world timestamps from the source metadata onto the video frames.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,APM-Bench分两个阶段构建. 在第一阶段,我们组织原始视频 与活动相关的轨迹。 就EgoLife而言,GPT-5-mini按小时和每日尺度生成分级摘要,GPT-5.4地雷则从每日摘要中生成165个轨迹建议。 人类注释员保留了76个由472会组成的有效轨迹. 就HD-EPIC而言,食谱阶段说明产生34个轨迹建议,其中28个轨迹涵盖77个会次,仍在人类核查之后。 对于HD-EPIC会话视频,没有可见的时间戳,我们从源元数据将真实世界的时间戳放入视频帧.

blocks.en: In Stage 2 , Gemini-3.5-Flash generates fine-grained timestamped visual captions for 30-second clips across all sessions. Given the full trajectory captions, DeepSeek-V4-Flash proposes Cross-session Understanding and Adaptive Response candidates; GPT-4o proposes Real-time Perception candidates from selected video frames and captions. The three capabilities yield 6,412 initial candidates. We then (1) remove shortcut candidates answered correctly without video by at least two of Qwen3.8-27B, GPT-5, and Gemini-3.1-Pro; (2) discard candidates whose timestamps violate causal constraints; (3) use a tool-augmented VLM agent to audit and refine the remaining candidates; and (4) conduct final human verification and refinement. For 300 questions randomly sampled from the final set, two independent annotators achieved a Cohen’s kappa of 0.868 0.868 ( Cohen, 1960 ) , supporting the reliability of the final annotations.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,双子座-3.5-Flash生成精细的有时间戳的视觉字幕,用于所有会话的30秒片段. 鉴于整个轨迹标题,DeepSeek-V4-Flash提出了跨会理解和适应性反应候选人;GPT-4o从选定的视频框和标题中提出了实时感知候选人。 这三种能力产生了6 412名初步候选人。 然后,我们 (1) 将至少两个Qwen3.8-27B、GPT-5和双子座-3.1-Pro正确回答的捷径候选人删除; (2) 丢弃其时间戳违反因果限制的候选人; (3) 使用工具强化的VLM代理来审计和完善其余候选人; (4) 进行最后的人文核查和完善. 对于从最终集中随机抽取的300个问题,两个独立的注释者实现了 Cohen 的 kappa 0.868 (Cohen, 1960),支持了最终注释的可靠性.

blocks.en: D.2 Human verification
blocks.zh: D.2 人的核查

blocks.en: Reviewers used the Human Verify & Refine console (Figure 11 , top) to inspect and revise the 3,249 candidates retained after automated screening. The console places source video and time targets beside the review criteria and editable annotations. For MCQA, reviewers checked question clarity, answer correctness and uniqueness, answerability at query time, evidence support, timestamp accuracy, agreement between evidence descriptions and video, and absence of future leakage. Ambiguous questions were removed.
blocks.zh: 评审人员使用人体验证和精准控制台(图11,顶部)对自动筛选后保留的3,249名考生进行检查和修改. 控制台将源视频和时间目标置于审查标准和可编辑说明之外。 就MCQA而言,审查人员检查了问题清晰度、回答正确性和独特性、查询时间的可回答性、证据支持、时间戳的准确性、证据描述和视频之间的一致以及未来没有渗漏。 模糊的问题被删除。

blocks.en: For Adaptive Response, reviewers checked each probe’s intervene/silent label, whether remembered evidence helped with the current task and matched the video, whether silence was justified, and whether response and silence reasons were supported. They checked that reference responses were correct, complete, natural, and useful; verified probe and ideal-response interval timestamps, MPA/TPG historical links, RCR/PRM registrations, and the absence of future leakage; and removed unnecessary interventions or candidates with weak historical links. Reference responses and reasons were refined. The ideal intervals support finer analysis of response timing.
blocks.zh: 就适应性反应而言,审查人员检查了每个探测器的干预/沉寂标签、记忆中的证据是否有助于当前的任务并匹配视频、沉默是否合理以及反应和沉默的理由是否得到支持。 他们检查了参考答复是否正确、完整、自然和有用;经核实的探测和理想-反应间隔时间戳、MPA/TPG历史联系、RCR/PRM登记和今后没有渗漏;删除了不必要的干预或历史联系薄弱的候选人。 对参考答复和理由作了改进。 理想的间隔支持对反应时间的更细化分析.
